budget_policy: Review threshold, never permission to delete core state. A populated database and its durable event export can already exceed a small development-artifact budget; retired builds have no such exception.

artifacts.purpose: Current read model, historical settings, ingest evidence and cursors
artifacts.schema: SQLite schema.sql user_version 1; required transaction side files have separate exact owners
artifacts.consumer_or_final_deliverable: console_store health, run history and coverage queries
artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: Preserve the current consistent database. Backfill does not recreate all historical settings, failed ingest attempts or events outside the OS log window.

retention_rule.rule: Never removed or truncated by artifact cleanup; exceeding 128 MiB requires a separate reviewed migration.

artifacts.purpose: Pending and checkpointed WAL transactions for the current database
artifacts.schema: SQLite wal side file paired with console.sqlite3
artifacts.consumer_or_final_deliverable: Current database consistency and transaction recovery
artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: Preserve with its live database until the writer is stopped and a consistent standalone recovery capture is verified. Do not copy live side files into the recovery archive.

retention_rule.rule: Never truncate or retire current transaction state through artifact cleanup. Exceeding this review threshold requires reviewed database maintenance.

artifacts.purpose: WAL shared-memory coordination for the current database
artifacts.schema: SQLite shm side file paired with console.sqlite3
artifacts.consumer_or_final_deliverable: Current database consistency and transaction recovery
artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: Preserve with its live database until the writer is stopped and a consistent standalone recovery capture is verified. Do not copy live side files into the recovery archive.

retention_rule.rule: Never truncate or retire current transaction state through artifact cleanup. Exceeding this review threshold requires reviewed database maintenance.

artifacts.purpose: Rollback-journal transaction recovery for the current database
artifacts.schema: SQLite journal side file paired with console.sqlite3
artifacts.consumer_or_final_deliverable: Current database consistency and transaction recovery
artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: Preserve with its live database until the writer is stopped and a consistent standalone recovery capture is verified. Do not copy live side files into the recovery archive.

retention_rule.rule: Never truncate or retire current transaction state through artifact cleanup. Exceeding this review threshold requires reviewed database maintenance.

artifacts.purpose: One compressed consistent database snapshot for versioned recovery
artifacts.schema: current.zip contains console.sqlite3 and schema_version 1 receipt.json; the separate current.json mirrors the receipt and archive digest
artifacts.producer: tools/backup_console_db.py manual refresh or scheduled bound-source publication
artifacts.consumer_or_final_deliverable: Private backup and verified database recovery
artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: Verify the archive before extraction. Restore only with the writer stopped and original state preserved.

retention_rule.rule: Keep one verified snapshot; reuse it if database bytes and schema/counts are unchanged. Scheduled mode commits and pushes only its pair through normal hooks on private main, rejecting unrelated staged or unpublished work. Never prune it as development output.

artifacts.purpose: Receipt for the one current consistent database recovery archive
artifacts.schema: Schema-version 1 receipt with database and archive digests, schema and table counts
artifacts.consumer_or_final_deliverable: Archive verification and private recovery
artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: Restore with the matching current.zip from one reviewed private revision; mismatched receipts fail verification.

retention_rule.rule: Keep the exact current receipt paired with current.zip. Additional recovery filenames are undeclared until reviewed.

artifacts.purpose: OS-lock coordination for consistent database snapshots
artifacts.schema: Opaque one-byte lock file; file presence does not establish lock ownership
artifacts.consumer_or_final_deliverable: Overlapping snapshot exclusion
artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: The backup helper recreates the lock file; the OS lock determines ownership.

retention_rule.rule: Keep while the helper may use it. Remove only after proving there is no lock holder; do not classify staged snapshots or extra archives through this path.

artifacts.purpose: Durable normalized run events beyond the rotating OS log window
artifacts.schema: JSONL e,r,t,i,ts,rc; event identity is e+r
artifacts.consumer_or_final_deliverable: Export watermark and durable event history
artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: Keep versioned in the private companion. It does not contain every database column or provide a complete database restore.

retention_rule.rule: Append without loss; report above 48 MiB for explicit partition or migration review, never silently discard old events.

artifacts.purpose: Current registration authority and transaction recovery
artifacts.schema: Current pointer, transaction journals, receipts, stages and locks
artifacts.consumer_or_final_deliverable: Registration recovery and launcher authority
artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: Restore the pointer with its referenced receipt and journal; preserve pending, conflict and uncleaned transactions. Pair current authority with the current protected-input archive declared by the private configuration backup owner's storage contract; see docs/storage.md for the manifest and DPAPI limits.

retention_rule.rule: Artifact cleanup never touches registration; review completed transactions separately above 8 MiB.

artifacts.purpose: Current installed launcher binding
artifacts.schema: Launcher binding schemaVersion 1
artifacts.consumer_or_final_deliverable: Console launcher
artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: Restore from private companion history and validate referenced installed runtime.

retention_rule.rule: Keep the current binding; never infer it from a development directory.

artifacts.purpose: Installed task declarations and source closure
artifacts.schema: Private runtime configuration, desired state, projections and observations
artifacts.consumer_or_final_deliverable: Current binding and registration authority
artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: Keep referenced declarations and recovery closure in the private companion.

retention_rule.rule: Protected from generic cleanup; remove a declaration only after a separate reference and recovery review.

artifacts.purpose: One bounded final result, current handoff receipts and cleanup receipt
artifacts.schema: Markdown conclusion and schema_version 1 JSON receipts
artifacts.consumer_or_final_deliverable: Operator review and current release handoff
artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: Version the concise final result; regenerate build payloads from committed sources.

retention_rule.rule: Replace the latest cleanup receipt; retain one final consolidated result under 256 KiB and the current release handoff only.

artifacts.purpose: Explicit completed-work retirement decisions
artifacts.schema: schema_version 1, at most 64 retirement entries and 256 KiB
artifacts.consumer_or_final_deliverable: tools/storage_retention.py and tools/cleanup_storage.ps1
artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: Reconstruct from the final result and source reconciliation; never infer approval from file age.

retention_rule.rule: Only completed, source-reconciled work with inactive writers and a retained result can enter the plan.

artifacts.purpose: Temporary builds, test environments and diagnostic outputs
artifacts.schema: Disposable build output with an explicit retirement record
artifacts.consumer_or_final_deliverable: Committed source and bounded final result
artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: Rebuild from committed source and the installed artifact authority.

retention_rule.rule: Close and retire after source reconciliation and final acceptance; do not keep complete build copies as history.

artifacts.purpose: Legacy console-repair development output
artifacts.schema: Legacy artifacts explicitly listed in the private retirement record
artifacts.consumer_or_final_deliverable: Consolidated final result and preserved useful tooling
artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: Committed source retains product changes; the latest handoff is preserved outside these trees.

retention_rule.rule: Only exact reviewed roots named by the retirement record may be removed after source reconciliation and writer/reference checks. This namespace has a bounded share of the combined 16 MiB legacy review budget.

artifacts.purpose: Finite memory diagnostic observations
artifacts.schema: Terminal session receipt, configuration and conclusion
artifacts.consumer_or_final_deliverable: Bounded diagnostic conclusion
artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: Start a new explicit diagnostic session when fresh samples are needed.

retention_rule.rule: After the session is terminal and its writer is absent, retain its conclusion/configuration and retire raw samples explicitly.

artifacts.purpose: Private maintenance conclusions and displaced local telemetry
artifacts.schema: Bounded legacy telemetry and maintenance receipts
artifacts.consumer_or_final_deliverable: Recoverable private maintenance state
artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: Keep in private companion history; never return runtime telemetry to the public tool.

retention_rule.rule: Preserve displaced original state until explicitly superseded; review above 1 MiB.

artifacts.purpose: Private repository text and archive attributes
artifacts.schema: Git attributes document
artifacts.consumer_or_final_deliverable: Private versioning and stable archive handling
artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: Restore the reviewed private repository revision.

retention_rule.rule: Retain this exact configuration until explicitly superseded.

artifacts.purpose: Private repository rules for transient live database state
artifacts.schema: Git ignore document
artifacts.consumer_or_final_deliverable: Private versioning without live SQLite side-file churn
artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: Restore the reviewed private repository revision.

retention_rule.rule: Retain this exact configuration; ignore rules do not authorize deleting untracked files.

artifacts.purpose: Private companion usage and recovery instructions
artifacts.schema: Markdown repository guide
artifacts.consumer_or_final_deliverable: Operator recovery and storage review
artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: Restore the reviewed private repository revision and consult the source-owned storage contract.

retention_rule.rule: Keep the current guide; do not retain copied source or logs as guide content.

artifacts.purpose: Empty private data-directory initialization marker
artifacts.schema: Empty file
artifacts.consumer_or_final_deliverable: Versioned empty data directory
artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: Recreate an empty marker when the data directory would otherwise be absent from Git.

retention_rule.rule: Retain only as an initialization marker; it carries no observations or recovery state.

artifacts.purpose: Current console-state layout and restore instructions
artifacts.schema: Markdown data guide
artifacts.consumer_or_final_deliverable: Database, event-ledger and registration operators
artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: Restore its reviewed private revision; domain tools remain authoritative for recovery.

retention_rule.rule: Keep this exact current guide without admitting arbitrary console logs or copied runtime source.

artifacts.purpose: Last complete successful ingestion timestamp
artifacts.schema: Timestamp text updated only after the complete ingestion succeeds
artifacts.consumer_or_final_deliverable: Ingest freshness checks
artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: A new successful ingestion refreshes it; preserve the previous stamp until that succeeds.

retention_rule.rule: Keep the current success stamp; age is an observation, never proof that ingestion currently succeeds.

artifacts.purpose: Operator-reviewed policy for a scoped private follow-up helper
artifacts.schema: Private helper configuration document
artifacts.consumer_or_final_deliverable: Private follow-up helper planning
artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: Restore the reviewed private configuration; never infer authority from a dated work directory.

retention_rule.rule: Keep the exact configured input until its consumer is reconciled; configuration is not deletion approval.

artifacts.purpose: Private follow-up helper source retained for source reconciliation
artifacts.schema: Python source files
artifacts.consumer_or_final_deliverable: Source reconciliation and reviewed follow-up planning
artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: Reconcile useful code into its source owner before retiring these private helper files.

retention_rule.rule: Keep until source ownership and current references are reconciled; do not archive generated work here.

artifacts.purpose: Instructions for the scoped private follow-up helper
artifacts.schema: Markdown helper guide
artifacts.consumer_or_final_deliverable: Reviewed private helper use
artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: Preserve useful instructions in the source owner before retiring this exact guide.

retention_rule.rule: Reconcile the guide with its source; private placement alone does not make it runtime core.

artifacts.purpose: Synthetic tests for retained private follow-up tooling
artifacts.schema: Python test sources and synthetic fixtures
artifacts.consumer_or_final_deliverable: Source reconciliation and test verification
artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: Recreate from the reconciled helper source; retain pending useful-code reconciliation.

retention_rule.rule: Retire only after useful tests are preserved in their source owner and writers and references are clear.

artifacts.purpose: Final listener and binding handoff helper
artifacts.schema: PowerShell release helper
artifacts.consumer_or_final_deliverable: Explicitly authorized console release handoff
artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: Reconcile useful handoff code into its source owner before retiring this exact helper.

retention_rule.rule: Keep pending source reconciliation and referenced release review; classification never authorizes running the helper.

artifacts.purpose: Instructions for the final release handoff helper
artifacts.schema: Markdown release guide
artifacts.consumer_or_final_deliverable: Explicit release operator review
artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: Reconcile useful instructions with the source-owned helper.

retention_rule.rule: Keep with its helper until source and current references are reconciled; no copied release payloads are admitted.

artifacts.purpose: Superseded profile snapshot and copied skill payloads
artifacts.schema: Legacy pointer, manifest and copied profile generation tree
artifacts.consumer_or_final_deliverable: Source reconciliation and reviewed retirement
artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: Compare current profile authority and retained useful source before any retirement; this copy is not a database recovery snapshot.

retention_rule.rule: Keep pending an exact reference, uniqueness and useful-code review. Retired classification alone does not prove it dispensable or allow removal.

artifacts.purpose: Historical one-click release development and diagnostic outputs
artifacts.schema: Legacy release scripts, receipts, screenshots and observations
artifacts.consumer_or_final_deliverable: Current release handoff and one bounded final conclusion
artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: Reconcile useful unique code and final evidence with source and current handoff; do not create another full release copy.

retention_rule.rule: Only exact reviewed roots may be retired after source and current-reference clearance; keep unresolved historical evidence until reviewed.

artifacts.purpose: Attributes belonging to the historical release workspace
artifacts.schema: Git attributes document
artifacts.consumer_or_final_deliverable: Reviewed legacy workspace retirement
artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: Useful rules belong in the private repository root configuration.

retention_rule.rule: Retire only with a reviewed legacy release group after useful settings are reconciled.

artifacts.purpose: Dated one-shot storage review watcher configuration and terminal observations
artifacts.schema: Watcher configuration, bounded receipts, terminal status and lock marker
artifacts.consumer_or_final_deliverable: One concise retained conclusion and source-owned watcher
artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: Retain required configuration and conclusion before retiring raw outputs; a lock file requires an inactive-holder check.

retention_rule.rule: Review exact terminal or superseded runs for source, result and writer clearance. This namespace is not a permitted new long-lived runtime store.
